cause_quote: The introducing diff added `const items = filteredItems(props.query, Boolean(props.onSlashCommand), props.sessionItems);`, feeding session results into the existing clickable `<div>` renderer, and routed selection through `props.onSelectSession?.(item.action.slice(SESSION_ACTION_PREFIX.length));`.
user_saw: Middle-clicking or using Cmd+click or Ctrl+click on a command palette result failed to open it in a new tab.
summary: The fix gives navigable palette results real links so browser new-tab gestures work while regular clicks still select the result in the current tab.
reasoning: I checked the commit that introduced palette session search and confirmed that session results used clickable divs with no link destination from their first release. The later message search and Solid migration retained that renderer behavior, and the fix adds end-to-end coverage for opening session and message results in new tabs while keeping the original palette open.
